## Activity

During June 2022, Market Eye Clinic recorded 375 captures. Capture activity was completed as scheduled, with session lists running as planned apart from routine leave. The recorded activity provides the basis for the image-quality and grading results set out below.

## Image quality

Of the 375 captures, 13 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 3.5 per cent. These images could not proceed to grading. The ungradable result is reported separately from the grading outcome so that overall activity and image-quality performance can be considered together.

## Grading

Grading identified 92 referable results. The median lag between capture and grading was 24 days. This measure represents the midpoint of the recorded waiting time for images that proceeded through the grading process. Overall, the June 2022 report records 375 captures, with 13 ungradable images and 92 referable results.
